Clare: Quick results from Aurora-9B quant sweep (fp16 / int8 / int6). sharing short econ + QA summary.
Jason: Thanks. headline numbers?
Clare: int6 token-cost ~50% lower vs fp16; int8 ~32% lower. Quality: int6 has visible omission issues on long-context summaries; int8 mostly parity.
Sara: How bad are omissions? human flags?
Clare: On 250 news-summary samples: int6 20% flagged shorter/missing context; int8 5% flagged.
Mohit: Latency/p95?
Clare: p50 fp16=90ms int8=95ms int6=80ms. p95 fp16=210ms int8=255ms int6=320ms (long-context cases).
Elaine: Looks like kv-cache fallback for int6 on long contexts. Can routing help?
Clare: Proposed routing: default=int6; if context_tokens>1024 -> int8; if summarization and length>600 -> fp16.
Jason: Simulated blend?
Clare: Blend -> 33% int6, 52% int8, 15% fp16; ~30% cost reduction vs fp16-only.
Sara: Recommend canary plan for GTN?
Clare: 1% traffic 48h with eval hooks, then 10% for 72h if stable; auto-rollback on p95+40% or human-flag >10%.
Mohit: I'll own canary infra (flags, exec-path logs).
Elaine: I'll wire rollback automation and alerts.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: canary/aurora9b/hybrid-quant -> env=canary split=1%
Sara: Please include 25 representative samples in ticket for product review.
Clare: Will attach CSV + scoring sheet. Target decision review Wed.
